span.p:
Middleware pipeline
Serilog → ExceptionHandler(RFC 7807)
→ CSP frame-ancestors 'self'
→ /_framework no-cache
→ BlazorFrameworkFiles → StaticFiles
→ Routing → AuthN → AuthZ

Auth — BFF
Cookie 'PoLocalCompare.Session'
HttpOnly · SameSite=Strict · Secure
OIDC code+PKCE · FakeAuthHandler (non-prod)
FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser
